summary: Second canvas-family umbrella, opened after the user spotted MPI-424 in done with family work still outstanding. Verified first: 424 is correctly closed - all five of its members shipped. The five open cards (426, 435, 436, 439, 421) were never members of it, so the fix is a new umbrella, not a reopen. Order and the one shared alpha-vs-luminance decision are in brief.md.

Umbrella #2 picked up. Order CORRECTED after reading all four member cards end to end: MPI-421 is not independent (it shares MpiCanvasViewer exec.onMasks with MPI-426, so they are a pair), and MPI-435 drops from second to last (pure polish, brushDab.js already shipped, blocks nothing). New order 426 -> 421 -> 436 -> 439 -> 435.

Member 1 of 5 shipped: MPI-426 done and user-validated (f64fc75e). Session ends here by choice, umbrella stays in doing. NEXT IS MPI-421 - it shares MpiCanvasViewer exec.onMasks with the card just closed, which is why the order was corrected to put it second. Standing decision now inherited by every remaining member: hasMask() means BAKED content only, and the op strip gates on it, so a bare detection leaves masked ops locked until Add. Still open and still needing ONE shared answer before 436/439 diverge: does an op read paint alpha or luminance, and do soft edges survive.
